subject.title: Add a slim Docker image mode with configurable APT package installation

question: Should OpenClaw support deployer-selected APT packages for pulled official Docker images through a production-safe derived-image/prebuild flow, or keep package customization build-time and documentation-only?
rationale: This changes the official container packaging and package-manager trust boundary, and the safest UX shape is a product/security decision rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Approve derived-image prebuild
options.body: Add a documented prebuild/restart workflow that builds a local image from the current official image before gateway restart, with no production entrypoint-time APT install.

options.title: Keep build-time only
options.body: Leave OPENCLAW_IMAGE_APT_PACKAGES as a local-build/custom-image feature and improve docs for Dockerfile or Compose users instead of adding new runtime behavior.

options.title: Allow dev startup fallback
options.body: Permit an explicit non-production startup installer only if failure, caching, root/user mode, and downtime semantics are clearly documented and tested.

recommendation.title: Approve derived-image prebuild
recommendation.body: Add a documented prebuild/restart workflow that builds a local image from the current official image before gateway restart, with no production entrypoint-time APT install.
